name: wrapper-statusline-callback
note: router.on_statusline(payload) callback fed by the statusline relay

name: wrapper-history-backward
note: consumed by agent-orchestrator task fake-wrapper-contract (before_seq, types, prev_seq, has_more_before)

name: any-mcp-cli
note: console script any-mcp: --config <path> (or ANY_MCP_CONFIG), --plugin, --transport stdio|http, --version, --help exits 0; exit 78 on config errors; stdio default

name: any-mcp-config
note: YAML: server, tools, python_path, plugins[] (name, plugin, namespace, allow, tags, timeout, reload_every, config); unknown keys rejected; VAR expansion

name: any-mcp-release
note: tag v0.1.0: pip install 'any-mcp @ git+https://github.com/szymonrychu/any-mcp@v0.1.0'; console script any-mcp

name: any-mcp-install
note: onStart hook: python -m venv /opt/any-mcp && /opt/any-mcp/bin/pip install 'any-mcp @ git+https://github.com/szymonrychu/any-mcp@v0.1.0'; writes any-mcp.yaml as JSON (valid YAML) using stdlib only; console script /opt/any-mcp/bin/any-mcp

name: agent-orchestrator-chart
note: oci://harbor.szymonrichert.pl/charts/agent-orchestrator (immutable versions: X.Y.Z on tag vX.Y.Z, X.Y.Z-main.<sha7> on main); values: image, agentImage, postgres {url | host, port, database, user, password | existingSecret, existingSecretKey} (required unless cnpg.enabled), cnpg {enabled: false, instances, storage, backup}, masterKey {existingSecret | value}, claude {existingSecret | token}, env (extra ORCH_*), components {api, dispatcher, ingester, reconciler}, serviceAccount, rbac.create, service, ingress {enabled: false, className, annotations, hosts, tls}; everything in the release namespace

name: agent-orchestrator-settings-env
note: ORCH_* env names: ORCH_DATABASE_URL, ORCH_MASTER_KEY(_FILE), ORCH_NAMESPACE (one namespace, no ORCH_CLUSTERS_NAMESPACE), ORCH_AGENT_IMAGE, ORCH_AGENT_IMAGES, ORCH_ALLOWED_CIDRS, ORCH_CLAUDE_SECRET_NAME, ORCH_ANY_MCP_REF, ORCH_ANY_MCP_CONFIG_FILE, ORCH_DISCARD_HOOK_COMMAND, ORCH_DISCARD_HOOK_URL, ORCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_*; set by the chart's settings ConfigMap

name: agent-orchestrator-image
note: harbor.szymonrichert.pl/containers/agent-orchestrator:<sha7> only (no derived agent image); agents run the claude-code-wrapper image set as agentImage / ORCH_AGENT_IMAGE, any-mcp installed by the rendered onStart hook

name: wrapper-on-start-hook
note: hooks.onStart: instance event fired once per ccw process start before peer join, resume_on_start and any session; blocking deny or on_error deny failure exits 1; envelope like preJoin, runs in the sessions root

name: wrapper-files-api
note: claude-code-wrapper GET /v1/sessions/{id}/files (root, path, entries[name,type,size,mtime], next_offset; limits.files_max_entries 2000) and /files/content (kind text|binary|too_large, 1 MiB); errors invalid_path, not_found, not_a_directory, not_a_file; consumed by agent-orchestrator task file-proxy-routes

name: wrapper-terminals-api
note: claude-code-wrapper POST|GET /v1/sessions/{id}/terminals, DELETE .../{terminal_id}, WS .../{terminal_id}/attach (binary PTY bytes; JSON resize, ping/pong, exit; replay 256 KiB; close 1000/1003/1009/1013); errors terminal_limit 409, terminal_not_found 404; consumed by agent-orchestrator tasks terminal-proxy-routes, terminal-ws-relay

name: orch-allowed-origins
note: ORCH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: CSV of scheme://host[:port]; refuses Origin-bearing WebSocket upgrades not listed (1008) and unlisted Origin on terminal POST/DELETE (403 forbidden_origin); agents-helmfile sets https://agents.szymonrichert.pl

name: orch-settings-menu
note: SessionsMenu settingsCategories: {id, label, onOpen}[] rendered in the settings section pinned to the drawer bottom; cluster-presets adds Presets; this epic removes only the Edit entry points, cluster-presets removes PATCH and the ClusterForm edit code

name: orch-presets-api
note: GET|POST /api/v1/presets, GET|PUT|DELETE /api/v1/presets/{preset_id}, POST /api/v1/presets/{preset_id}/copy; PresetView {id, name, is_default, spec (sparse, only set keys), created_at, updated_at}; errors preset_default, last_preset, conflict; task preset-routes

name: orch-cluster-create-api
note: POST /api/v1/clusters {slug?, spec? | preset_id?}: exactly one of spec or preset_id, slug required with spec, generated from the preset name otherwise; ClusterView preset_id, preset_name; PATCH /api/v1/clusters/{id} retired (405); smoke.sh keeps the raw spec body; task create-cluster-from-preset

name: orch-cluster-spec-init-scripts
note: ClusterSpec.init_scripts: list[str] = [] (<=20 entries, each non-empty, <=16384 chars); spec.INIT_DIR='.agent-init'; spec.init_scripts_hash(scripts)=sha256 hex of compact JSON; never rendered (hash invariant); task init-scripts-spec-field

name: orch-cluster-status-init
note: clusters.status.init {state skipped|running|succeeded|failed, scripts_hash, started_at, finished_at, exit_code, log_tail, reason (job_missing|foreign_object|timeout|job_create_failed: ...), job}; reconciler-written once per cluster via Job agent-<slug>-init; sessions held while absent or running; failed -> degraded, sessions start; task init-job-runner

name: orch-init-workdir-files
note: <workdir_path>/.agent-init/init.sh (scripts as run, sh -eu), init.log, .gitignore '*'; written by the init Job on the shared workdir; the OrchestratorPlugin init_scripts_get description (hive F1) names .agent-init/init.sh and that edits apply to the next cluster; task init-job-runner

name: orch-cluster-init-scripts-api
note: GET|PUT /api/v1/clusters/{id}/init-scripts; PUT body {scripts}; InitScriptsView {cluster_id, scripts, preset_id, preset_name, status: InitStatus|null, edited_since_run, script_path, log_path, preset_updated}; PUT writes clusters.spec.init_scripts (no generation bump) and the source preset's spec.init_scripts in one transaction; errors invalid_request 422, not_found 404, conflict 409 (deleting); ClusterView.init_edited_since_run; task init-scripts-public-api

name: orch-agent-init-scripts-api
note: GET|PUT /agent/v1/init-scripts behind hive require_agent() (Bearer ORCH_AGENT_TOKEN, X-Orch-Cluster, caller IP = agents.pod_ip); same InitScriptsIn {scripts} and InitScriptsView as the public route, cluster = the token's cluster; consumed by OrchestratorPlugin tools orchestrator_init_scripts_get / orchestrator_init_scripts_edit built by hive F1 against this shape; task init-scripts-agent-api

name: orch-cluster-scale-api
note: POST /api/v1/clusters/{id}/scale {replicas} -> 202 ScaleResult {cluster_id, replicas, previous_replicas, max_replicas}; errors static_cluster 409, out_of_range 422, leader_would_leave 409, cluster_deleting 409, not_found 404; spec.replicas in place, no generation bump

name: orch-agent-scale-api
note: POST /agent/v1/scale {replicas} -> 202 ScaleResult; leader only via require_agent(); errors not_leader 403, static_cluster 409, out_of_range 422, leader_would_leave 409, cluster_deleting 409; consumed by OrchestratorPlugin orchestrator_scale

name: any-mcp-orchestrator-plugin
note: task orchestrator-plugin: OrchestratorPlugin Config{base_url, token, cluster, agent, slug, max_replicas, static, hive, auto_compact_pct}; tools orchestrator_{me,leadership_handover,lock_claim,lock_release,lock_list,lock_reassign,scale,init_scripts_get,init_scripts_edit}; scale calls POST /agent/v1/scale {replicas}; init tools GET/PUT /agent/v1/init-scripts {scripts}; server error.code surfaces in the tool error

name: any-mcp-release-v0-2-0
note: task any-mcp-release-v0-2-0: tag v0.2.0 carries the plugin; no further any-mcp release planned

name: wrapper-notes-inbox
note: task wrapper-notes-inbox: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/notes {text, key?, source?}, notes.enabled (hive only), events note_received/note_delivered

name: wrapper-main-agent-only-tools
note: task main-agent-only-tools: claude.main_agent_only_tools globs; rendered [mcp__any-mcp__orchestrator_*], so scale and init edit are main-agent only

name: orch-hive-tables
note: task migration-0003-hive: leadership_requests (api inserts, dispatcher decides), cluster_leaders (dispatcher), file_locks (api), agents.pod_ip (reconciler); later epics use migrations 0004+

name: orch-spec-cap-static
note: task spec-cap-static: ClusterSpec.max_replicas (default replicas, <=16 and settings cap), static (requires max_replicas == replicas), properties hive/alone/scalable; form inputs in task spec-form-cap-static

name: orch-agent-env
note: task agent-token-env-render: tokens purpose agent; Secret key and pod env ORCH_AGENT_TOKEN, ORCH_AGENT_URL, ORCH_CLUSTER_ID; passthrough plus POD_NAME

name: orch-agents-service
note: task chart-agents-service: ClusterIP <fullname>-agents:8001, never in the ingress; settings ORCH_AGENT_PORT, ORCH_AGENT_API_URL

name: orch-agent-api-auth
note: task agent-api-me: /agent/v1 router on the agent port only; require_agent() (Bearer token + X-Orch-Cluster, caller IP = agents.pod_ip) returns the agents row; GET /agent/v1/me {cluster_id, agent_id, pod_name, ordinal, leader, epoch, max_replicas, static, members[]}; errors 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden

name: orch-leader-read
note: task leadership-requests-api: current_leader(conn, cluster_id) -> (agent_id, pod_name, epoch) | None; for leader-only scale and leader_would_leave

name: orch-leadership-pass
note: task dispatcher-leadership-pass: leadership_pass under the per-cluster claim lock; lost-leader fallback when a leader is gone or unready past 30 s; NOTIFY leader_changed

name: orch-render-hash-invariant
note: task render-hive-gating: test_runtime_fields_change_only_statefulset_replicas, parametrised over runtime fields; init adds init_scripts; nothing rendered may depend on the live replica count

name: orch-peer-seeds-cap
note: task render-hive-gating: peers.static = ordinals 0..max_replicas-1; peers.enabled = spec.peers and hive; notes.enabled = hive

name: orch-plugin-entry
note: task plugin-config-merge: orchestrator_allow(spec) is the only extension point (scaling adds scale when scalable, init adds init_scripts_get/edit always); entry omitted when allow is empty

name: orch-hive-state-note
note: task hive-state-push-loop: keyed hive_state note {leader, epoch, you, members[], max_replicas, static} pushed on leader or membership change by the dispatcher

name: orch-spec-runtime-mutable
note: task hive-docs-memory: spec.replicas and spec.init_scripts are the only in-place spec fields (no generation bump, no pod roll); writers are the api routes of the consuming epics; PATCH stays 405

name: orch-cluster-config-api
note: task config-cluster-views: ClusterSpec.wrapper (typed wrapper settings: hooks on 21 events command|webhook, auto_compact, system_append, permissions, mcp_servers, plugins, turn_stall_seconds, max_restarts, restart_continue_prompt, turn_max_seconds, agent_commands), leader_lease_seconds (60..604800, hive only), autoclose_after_seconds (>= ORCH_AUTOCLOSE_MIN_SECONDS, default 300) on POST /api/v1/clusters and the preset routes; ClusterView closes_at, leader_since, leader_reason; README ### Cluster configuration

name: orch-leader-lease
note: task leader-lease-expiry: leadership_pass step 4 hands leadership to _free_longest at the leader's turn boundary once since is older than spec.leader_lease_seconds; reason lease_expired, epoch+1; no takeover, no interrupted turn; amends hive D26 for opted-in clusters

name: orch-cluster-autoclose
note: task autoclose-sweeper: api-process sweeper (AUTOCLOSE_POLL_SECONDS 10) calls close_expired, a status-guarded desired active->deleting flip at created_at + spec.autoclose_after_seconds; the reconciler discards as for DELETE; api stays the only writer of clusters.desired

name: web-settings-menu-order
note: task web-clusters-page: settingsCategories order Clusters first, Presets last; the webhook and schedule epics insert their entries between them (they register contract use when planned, blocked by configuration-improvements)
